environment.description: Actix-web task worker deployed on a bare EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e) in VPC vpc-9d8e7f6a, subnet-public-1a. Security group sg-0x4a2b allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer or reverse proxy in front. Instance has public IPv4 address. IAM role attached has no restrictions on outbound network. Service runs as ec2-user with standard Amazon Linux 2 permissions.
